Topic Guides inside the Punjab Exam Syllabus

Where a subject guide covers the whole subject, a topic guide zooms into one chapter: its scope, how it has been asked, the facts that get repeated and the set to attempt after reading.

Quick answer

Topic guides sit between a study note and a subject guide - one chapter, fully explained, with the exam pattern for that chapter and the practice set attached to it. Each guide links to its subject hub, the related notes and the quiz that tests it.
